details.description:
Dr. Oetker FunFoods Pasta & Pizza Sauce brings authentic Italian flavor to your kitchen. Made with fresh tomatoes and Italian herbs, it’s perfect for pasta, pizza, or quick family meals. Ready-to-use 750g pack ensures rich, tangy-herby taste every time.
How to Use
Pizza: Spread 2 tbsp. of this sauce on an 8 Pizza base. Scatter vegetable or meat toppings and sprinkle 2 tbsp. of grated cheese and bake for 15 mins at 180 degrees Celsius in a preheated oven and serve hot.
Pasta: Boil 1.5 L of water and add 1 tbsp. of salt and 150 gm of pasta. Cook for 8-11 mins and drain water. Warm 150 g of sauce and 4 tbsp. of water in a pan. Add boiled pasta and toss. Serve hot.
